_about: Names and descriptions for the listening page (beads/test/listen.py). 'folders' says which version of the firmware a folder holds; 'renders' says what each harness render is. Keys are repo-relative folder paths and WAV file names. A render's value is text, or {label, about} to give options that share a folder their own titles. A folder without an entry shows its path.

audio_samples.label: Source
audio_samples.description: The input fed to every render, unprocessed.

renders/stock.label: Stock
renders/stock.description: Upstream firmware, before any Soft Beads change. The reference.

renders/stock-shape.label: Stock · Shape positions
renders/stock-shape.description: Upstream firmware on the cloud patch at the same five knob positions as ticket 09, plus its bell (Shape 0.66, beads_cloud). Knob positions mean different windows here: stock runs square, decay, bell, reverse.

renders/09-shape-sweep.label: 09 · Shape morph
renders/09-shape-sweep.description: Shape remapped to one continuous morph: decay, square, Tukey, Hann, Gaussian. Reverse is gone. Includes every earlier change. beads_cloud is at Hann.

renders/10-diffuser.label: 10 · Diffuser
renders/10-diffuser.description: The diffuser as picked: kap 0.5 with the first line of each channel slowly modulated, on the wet bus, faded in with an equal-power blend from Hann (off) to fully clockwise (full). Includes every earlier change. Below Hann these are byte-identical to 09.

renders/sources.label: Sources · dry
renders/sources.description: Extra dry sources: picked guitar (Sublustris clip 09, CC0 Emily guitar), sustained poly synth chords (clip 08, synthesised), drum groove with stabs (clip 03, CC0 drums). 30 s, looped where shorter.

renders/04-wet-gain.label: 04 · Wet gain 0.94
renders/04-wet-gain.description: Wet gain lowered from 1.5 to 0.94, so a dense cloud at 12 o'clock sits within 1 dB of the dry.

renders/05-envelope-sum.label: 05 · Envelope-sum normalisation
renders/05-envelope-sum.description: The wet bus is scaled by 1/max(Σenv, 1) instead of 1/√n per grain at birth. Includes ticket 04.

renders/06-wet-saturator.label: 06 · Wet saturator at −6 dBFS
renders/06-wet-saturator.description: Wet bus untouched below −6 dBFS, then a tanh curve toward 0 dBFS. Includes 04 and 05.

renders/07-min-attack.label: 07 · Minimum attack 3 ms
renders/07-min-attack.description: Grain attack floor raised from 0.5 ms to 3 ms. Includes 04, 05 and 06.

renders/08-voice-stealing-fade.label: 08 · Current code
renders/08-voice-stealing-fade.description: Includes 04 to 07. Ticket 08 kept the 5 ms fade, so the DSP is unchanged from 07.

renders/16-wet-level.label: 16 · Wet level with random Time
renders/16-wet-level.description: Bus gain blends from 1/sum towards 1/sqrt(sum) when Time or Pitch is randomised. Max blend 0.75, sensitivity 100. Renders with fixed Time are bit-identical to 08.

renders/check.label: Latest check run
renders/check.description: Whatever the working tree rendered on the last `measure.py --check`. Not a fixed version.

renders/11-random-grain-level.label: 11: random grain level
renders/11-random-grain-level.description: Each grain gets a random level at birth, spread over 6 dB and growing across Density's random half. Make-up gain holds the average, so the cloud keeps its level.

renders/13-stereo-width.label: 13: stereo width
renders/13-stereo-width.description: Pan floor of ±30% plus opposite L/R level of about ±1 dB on the wet path. Mono inputs unchanged.

renders.kettel.wav: The test source: 48 kHz stereo, as fed to the harness.
renders.beads_processor.wav: The full module: Density 0.7, mix 0.9, a little reverb, 30 s. Closest to playing it.
renders.beads_granular_player.wav: The grain engine alone, before mix and reverb.
renders.beads_granular_processor.wav: The granular processor alone, before the dry/wet mix and reverb.
renders.beads_wetdry_wet.wav: Fully wet, Density 0.9, no reverb or feedback. Nothing is randomised, so it sounds close to the source delayed by about 0.4 s. There's no dry in it. For grain character, use beads_cloud.wav.
renders.beads_wetdry_dry.wav: Fully dry, same patch. What the wet is level-matched against.
renders.beads_drive_hot.wav: Fully wet, dense cloud, source 6 dB hotter than normal. Drives peaks into the saturator; listen to transients and the loudest swells.
renders.beads_drive_quiet.wav: Fully wet, dense cloud, source 12 dB down. Below the saturator; should sound identical across versions.
renders.beads_steal_s090.wav: Fully wet, Size 0.9, Density 0.9. About 38 grains want to overlap in a 32-grain pool, so voice stealing runs.
renders.beads_steal_s098.wav: Fully wet, Size 0.98, Density 0.9, the longest grains before delay mode. About 83 grains want to overlap in a 32-grain pool, so voice stealing runs hard.
renders.beads_cloud.wav: Fully wet, a properly granular cloud: Density 0.9, Size 0.75, Shape at the bell, Time spread over about a second per grain, Pitch fixed. No reverb or feedback.
renders.beads_cloud_hot.wav: The granular cloud with the source 6 dB hotter, driving the saturator.
renders.beads_cloudlevel_d060.wav: Granular cloud at Density 0.6, Time spread 0.25, 15 s.
renders.beads_cloudlevel_d070.wav: Granular cloud at Density 0.7, Time spread 0.25, 15 s.
renders.beads_cloudlevel_d080.wav: Granular cloud at Density 0.8, Time spread 0.25, 15 s.
renders.beads_cloudlevel_d090.wav: Granular cloud at Density 0.9, Time spread 0.25, 15 s.
renders.beads_cloudlevel_d100.wav: Granular cloud at Density 1.0, Time spread 0.25, 15 s.
renders.beads_cloudlevel_t000.wav: Density 0.9 with Time spread 0: grains in phase, 15 s.
renders.beads_density_000.wav: Fully wet, Density 0.0 (regular, audio-rate end), 15 s.
renders.beads_density_100.wav: Fully wet, Density 1.0 (random, audio-rate end), 15 s.
renders.beads_shape_000.wav: Cloud patch, Shape fully anticlockwise. 09: decay. Stock: square.
renders.beads_shape_025.wav: Cloud patch, Shape 9 o'clock. 09: square. Stock: on the way to decay.
renders.beads_shape_050.wav: Cloud patch, Shape 12 o'clock. 09: Tukey. Stock: just past decay.
renders.beads_shape_075.wav: Cloud patch, Shape 3 o'clock. 09: Hann. Stock: just past the bell.
renders.guitar.wav: Picked guitar chords in D, dry.
renders.beads_shape_088.wav: Cloud patch, Shape halfway from 3 o'clock to fully clockwise. 10: half Hann-to-Gaussian, half diffuser.
renders.beads_shape_100.wav: Cloud patch, Shape fully clockwise. 09: Gaussian. 10: Gaussian with the full diffuser. Stock: reverse.
renders.beads_width_clocked.wav: Clocked and nothing randomised, on a source summed to mono. The width check's render.
renders.beads_width_stereo.wav: Clocked and nothing randomised, on the source as it is.
renders.beads_width_mono.wav: Clocked with a mono input. L and R must match exactly.
renders.beads_width_mono_cloud.wav: Randomised cloud with a mono input. Must render as it did before ticket 13.
